race.comment: TORO STRIKE (4) stepped up to this trip here nearly 3 weeks ago, and improved quickly to finish second as the favourite in his first start from the Jack Bruce stable. He won't have to improve by much to go one better in this. WOUNDER (8) has been holding her form deep into her prep, and dropping back from a middle distance should do her no harm. A tricky gate is the only query, but she can still figure in the top 4 in an even contest. MADAME CODY (9) had been trialling up well before needing the run badly fresh up at the Gold Coast just over 2 weeks ago. The key here is Daniel Moor replacing an apprentice, and she can improve sharply second up. Include in all combos. BINGI (1) did nothing fresh up as a gelding in his first run from a new stable, and the blinkers go straight back on. Don't drop him yet.
